Name this tailnet

A short id for its namespace and DNS. Lowercase, no spaces.

Tailscalelogin.tailscale.com — the default coordination server
Headscale (self-hosted)Point at your own control URL

How should it authenticate?

hydrascale runs tailscale up inside the namespace.

Auth keyReusable or one-off key from the admin console
Interactive loginPrint a URL to authorize in a browser
Read key from filePass --auth-key=file: so the secret stays out of argv

Networking

Defaults are safe — host access and routes are opt-in.

Accept MagicDNSResolve *.ts.net peers from the host
Host accessReach this tailnet's peers from the host over veth
Advertise as exit nodeOffer this host as an exit node

Remove jbones?

hydrascale tears this tailnet down on host mars. This can't be undone from here.

Runs tailscale logout, deletes namespace ns-jbones, removes its veth & iptables rules, and clears /var/lib/hydrascale/jbones.
The node stays authorized in your Tailscale admin console until you remove it there.
